# TestScript for 22-app-deprecation
# Asserts whole-command deprecation: the warning banner on root, subcommand,
# and --help invocations, alongside normal output and exit codes

# 1. Root invocation: banner on stderr, output and exit code unaffected
exec app-deprecated
stderr 'WARNING: app-deprecated is deprecated: use the new unified tool'
stdout '⚙  app-deprecated'
stdout 'root command executed'

# 2. Subcommand invocation: same banner
exec app-deprecated deploy -f
stderr 'WARNING: app-deprecated is deprecated: use the new unified tool'
stdout '⚙  app-deprecated deploy'
stdout 'deployment started'

# 3. --help also carries the banner above the usage screen (banner streams
#    to stdout there, alongside the help screen itself)
exec app-deprecated --help
stdout 'WARNING: app-deprecated is deprecated: use the new unified tool'
stdout 'Usage:'
